problems: e4: ball ↔ header-socket is not a compatible pair
notes: The soil moisture sensor type 'moisture-grove-soil' was taken from the parts matching; its ports are not listed, so edges to it use no port.
The MKR WiFi 1010 plugs into the MKR IoT Carrier header; the exact pin mapping is not given, so it is a single joined edge with no port on the MKR side.

The MKR IoT Carrier is a new part type. Relay 1 NO and COM are modelled as screw-terminal lugs, with COM-NO as a switched 'through' path. The Grove A6 connector is modelled as a header-socket so the Grove cable's wire-end fits it.
The pump outlet is a 'bar' and the pipe ends are 'clip' ports. This is the nearest compatible port pair for a hose pushed onto a nozzle.
The tutorial text says relay 1, but the sketch uses Relay2. I followed the text.
The tip about a connector strip is optional. I wired the open-ended USB + wire straight to NO, the pump + wire to COM, and the two negative wires together.
The USB adapter's wall plug, the plant, the soil and the pipe's far end in the pot are not modelled.
The Micro-USB cable is the catalogue usb-cable, which has no ports, so its edges use no ports.
The open-ended USB cable's USB plug end is a new port 'USB' on that cable type.
